_comment: Pre-declared before running: a second stock reference at two eta points, to tell whether the offsets seen in every eta port run come from the shared stock reference or from the port. Committed before the stock runs start; read only by the rule below. It does not change the outcome of v_rerun_envelope_eta_20261029.json (envelope not validated for eta).

runs.22166445: stock sampler, seed offset 1e6 (control; V2 fails: tail pull -3.09 > 3)

observation.note: the four port runs are independent; the stock reference sample is the same in all four

second_reference.cards: phase0/cards/ref_r2/{mb_eta_m005,he_eta_cuboid_m005}.dat (make_ref_repeat_cards.py): ref cards with seed + 1000000, same samplesize and max_trials
second_reference.build: stock -O2, as the first reference (superseded by the amendment below)

tests.A_first_vs_second_reference: compare_stock_refs.py --config validation/v_config_eta.json: the 14 V2 histograms and 2 tail checks per point, binned and cut on the first reference, the second in the port's place
tests.B_ports_vs_second_reference: compare_v.py --config validation/v_config_eta.json --stock-dir validation/out/stock_r2 --points mb_eta_m005 he_eta_cuboid_m005, for each of the four port runs' shards

decision_rule.reference: A shows the offset (he_eta_cuboid_m005 theta_e tail pull <= -2, i.e. the first reference has more tail than the second, or mb_eta_m005 theta_e|E_e_q0 p < 0.05) AND in B the mean of the four he_eta_cuboid_m005 theta_e tail pulls is within +-1.5 and mb_eta_m005 theta_e|E_e_q0 has p > 0.01 in all four runs
decision_rule.port: in B the mean of the four he_eta_cuboid_m005 theta_e tail pulls is <= -2, or mb_eta_m005 theta_e|E_e_q0 has p < 0.01 in two or more of the four runs

consequences.reference: the control's V2 failure is reported as a reference fluctuation (with this check); the stock-sampler eta configuration stays validated on its first run
consequences.port: eta is not called validated in the docs until the cause at these points is found
consequences.inconclusive: reported as such; both references are kept on record

decision_rule.reporting: the result of A and B and the verdict go into docs/gpu-validation.md whatever the outcome

amendment_2026-10-29.change: the second reference is run on a UVA CPU node with a Linux build of the same source (fork commit bf45d75, BdNMC_LANL c858395, no local changes; gcc 14.2.0, built -O2 -fPIC by the user), not with the laptop build
amendment_2026-10-29.why: time: two single-core jobs start at once there; the laptop mb_eta_m005 run was at 12 % after 7 minutes
amendment_2026-10-29.laptop_runs: the laptop runs of the two cards started at 17:01 were stopped at 17:09, unfinished; none of their results were read (only their event counts, for progress) and they are not used
amendment_2026-10-29.effect: a different compiler and standard library may give different events at the same seed; the sampled law is the same, so this is still an independent stock reference. If A shows a difference, the build is a possible cause and is reported as such. Tests and rule unchanged.
